Dress 4 Colour 2021 – Fashion Week MN Runway Event

Thu, Apr 29, 2021 · 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM · Online

When
Thu, Apr 29, 2021 · 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM
Where
Online

IamMoody is excited to produce our Spring 2021 Fashion Show Dress 4 Colour. This runway show will feature amazing local designers and diverse models.

The show will be streamed online from The Apt event space. We anticipate offering a few in-person seats along the runway. ou will want to mark “Going” on this event invite to get notified.
